column1: # Regression fixtures for scripts/dead_candidate_scan.py.
#   name <TAB> expected-class <TAB> provenance
# expected-class is one of: published-result, load-bearing, uncertain. Issue
# #4976 retired the fourth class and with it the weak `not-safe` expectation,
# which was defined by reference to it ("anything but that class") and would
# have gone vacuously true. Every row now names an exact class: the 10 rows that
# carried `not-safe` were replaced by the class each one actually classifies as,
# measured by `--expect` at implementation HEAD 95d37da0 -- 7 published-result
# (the documentation channel wins over their Lean consumers) and 3 load-bearing
# (pseudoMassG_analyticAt, pseudoMassG_analyticWithinAt_Ici_zero,
# freeEnergyAlongExhaustion_nonneg_of_ferromagnetic). That is a strict
# tightening; no row expected the retired class, so nothing was dropped.
# Run with:  python3 scripts/dead_candidate_scan.py --expect scripts/audit/dead_candidate_fixtures.tsv
# Every row below is a *measured* fact about the tree, not a recollection. The
# 10 PR #4641 keepers are the primary acceptance test and split 7/3: reading
# only Lean rescues the first seven, reading only docs rescues the last three.
# Family-level calibration on the #4927 post-deletion tree based on e7d3c5f2,
# `--pattern '_ferromagnetic$'`:
#   219 candidates -> 103 uncertain (15 of them carrying no evidence at all,
#   88 charged), 81 load-bearing, 35 published-result; 110 of the 219 have zero
#   Lean consumers. The 103 was re-measured after #4976 folded the retired class
#   into uncertain (88 + 15); every other integer is unchanged.
# These integers are asserted by FamilyCalibrationTest in
# scripts/test_dead_candidate_scan.py; they are main-relative and must be
# refreshed there and here together, with a justification, when they move.
# The resolved-glob elision-head repair was measured against exact base
# 370f7033 over all 10606 unique declaration names. It adds 205 unique shorthand
# evidence strings and removes no evidence; exact/module/unreadable evidence is
# unchanged. Verdicts move only away from deletion eligibility: 49 no-evidence
# -> charged, 11 no-evidence -> load-bearing, and 12 charged ->
# load-bearing. Family labels move 387 -> 381 by removing six labels that now
# have concrete immediate-sibling targets; no label is added. All 18 fixture
# verdict rows below remain unchanged.
# The fully-qualified IsingModel-glob repair was measured against fixed base
# a09267ce over all 10606 declarations: the 18 fixture verdicts stay unchanged,
# citation evidence removes 0 and adds exactly 20 shorthand / 0 exact charges,
# verdict changes and movements toward deletion are both 0, and family labels move
# 378 -> 387 by adding exactly the nine wide qualified-token sites.
# Last move: the narrow-glob repair (a glob/ellipsis citation naming at most
# MAX_CHARGED_GLOB_MATCHES = 10 declarations is charged to all of them instead of
# being attributed to nobody) took 3 candidates out of the no-evidence state, 2
# into charged-uncertain and 1 into load-bearing through the delete-closure, and
# moved a fourth from charged to load-bearing. Whole-library: no-evidence
# 1091 -> 976, charged 691 -> 761, load-bearing 2081 -> 2126, published-result
# unchanged at 7009, with no verdict moving toward no-evidence.
# The concrete positive-pair row below is uncertain because the current shorthands
# charge all 7 of 7 ferromagnetic declarations and all 5 of 5 pair-positive declarations.
# The synthetic `test_qualified_globs_keep_the_1_2_10_11_threshold` pins the
# chargeable 10 / unchargeable 11 boundary directly. The no-evidence report is
# pinned separately by `test_isolated_candidate_exits_zero` using a current
# zero-consumer, zero-citation candidate.
# Before that: PR #4754 (deletion batch 4) took the family from 47/77 to
# 46/78, and the elided-prefix rule (a suffix citation whose elided prefix is
# spelled out on the same documentation line is a shorthand for the siblings
# that share it, not a family label) took 45 candidates out of the no-evidence
# state, 33 into charged and 12 into load-bearing through the delete-closure. This
# header had also drifted twice: it carried 263/132/143 from main 0922a812 while
# the test asserted 223/92/112, and then 47/77 while the test asserted 46/78.
# The gap between "no consumer" and "no evidence" is the *delete*
# closure: a lemma consumed only by another candidate loses that reference with it,
# but only if that other candidate is itself deleted. An earlier revision seeded the
# closure with every candidate and then let the classifier retain some of them,
# which left 15 lemmas reporting no evidence whose only consumer the same run reported
# as a keeper. The closure is sound only over the candidates that actually go
# away, so the retained ones are now removed before the fixpoint runs.
